skills.name: Prayer
lines: State of strengthening and inspiring all party members with the power of prayers.
* Activates status Praying on user: applies effects from Prayer skills on all party members
* Effects of Prayer skill used last will be reapplied at start of each turn for the duration of prayer.
* When multiple invokers activate prayer:
** Prayer Effects will be overwritten by newest prayer from other characters, but previous invoker will still be in praying state until remaining duration ends
** If the newest activated prayer state is disrupted, then the previous invoker's Prayer Effects will be active given they are still in the praying state.
* Does not replace active Zones and Songs and vice versa, can be active at the same time.
* Is not considered a Zone for Zone-related skill effects.
